title: Enrollment Operations Rule: Active and Pending Primary Care Provider Assignments
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — one active PCP at a time, and when an assignment can be created.**

### 1. Formal rule

1.1 At any date a member has exactly one active primary care provider (PCP). When a pending assignment becomes active, the previously active assignment ends on the day before, and it ends as **superseded**.

1.2 A new change request made while another assignment is still pending-effective withdraws the earlier pending assignment, which ends as **superseded**, instead of stacking a third open assignment. The withdrawn change does not count toward the change limit.

1.3 A Primary Care Provider Assignment is created only while the member's plan membership is in **pending, active, renewal-due or reconsideration** status. The status read is the one on the system record of the plan membership the assignment belongs to, as it stands before the assignment is created; the member's own description of their coverage does not replace it.

### 2. Open-assignment limit by practice type

| Practice type | Most open assignments (pending-effective plus active) a member may hold |
|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 2 |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 2 |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 2 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 2 |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 2 |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 2 |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 2 |

### 3. Lifecycle of an assignment

| From | To | Brought about by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending-effective | Active | The system | The assignment's effective date arrives and the provider becomes the member's PCP. |
| Pending-effective | Ended | The agent | A pending assignment is withdrawn at the member's request, or superseded by a later request before it takes effect. |
| Active | Ended | The system | The assignment is superseded by a newly effective one, the provider leaves the network or dismisses the member, the member ages out, or the membership ends. |

### 4. Membership status and assignment creation

Rule 1.3 lists the only statuses in which an assignment is created, so the table is complete.

| Plan membership status on the record | Assignment may be created |
|---|---|
| Pending | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Renewal-due | Yes |
| Reconsideration | Yes |
| Suspended | No |
| Terminated | No |

### 5. Worked illustration (hypothetical dates)

A member's active assignment is with Practice A. A change to Practice B is pending, effective on the first of next month. Before that date the member asks for Practice C instead. Under 1.2, the pending Practice B assignment is withdrawn as superseded, the Practice C assignment becomes the one pending assignment, and the withdrawn change to Practice B does not count toward the change limit. When the Practice C assignment becomes active, the Practice A assignment ends on the day before, as superseded (1.1).
